name: prism-models
title: Prism Models
purpose: Decides whether one language or reasoning model routed into the Prism from a hub such as Hugging Face may be fetched or run in the owner's browser, so that only a model pinned by revision and hash, in a format with a locked runtime, granted by the owner, runs, and nothing moves while the Prism is halted.

fields.name: source
fields.means: whether the model's hub, repository, revision and every file it loads are pinned by SHA-256 in the models lock

fields.name: format
fields.means: the standard the model's weights are written in: ONNX, GGUF, or anything else

fields.name: runtime
fields.means: whether the runtime bytes for that format (the ONNX or GGUF engine), read back from the browser store, equal the ones in the lock

fields.name: weights
fields.means: whether the model's weight and tokenizer files, read back from the browser store, equal the ones in the lock

fields.name: route
fields.means: whether the owner's grant names this model as one routed into the Prism

fields.name: halted
fields.means: whether the owner's kill switch has halted the Prism

rules.says: when halted is yes then refuse
rules.why: the kill switch stops every model

rules.says: when source is unlocked then refuse
rules.why: only a model pinned by revision and hash is routed into the Prism

rules.says: when format is other then refuse
rules.why: the Prism runs only a format it holds a locked runtime for

rules.says: when runtime is mismatch then refuse
rules.why: runtime bytes that differ from the lock could compute anything

rules.says: when weights is mismatch then refuse
rules.why: weights that differ from the lock are not the model the owner granted

rules.says: when route is ungranted then ask
rules.why: the owner decides which models are routed into the Prism

rules.says: when runtime is missing then fetch
rules.why: the locked runtime is fetched from this page, checked, then kept

rules.says: when weights is missing then fetch
rules.why: the locked weights are fetched from this page, checked, then kept

properties.says: never when halted is yes then run
properties.why: a halted Prism would still compute

properties.says: never when halted is yes then fetch
properties.why: a halted Prism would still move bytes

properties.says: never when source is unlocked then run
properties.why: a model nobody pinned could be swapped upstream

properties.says: never when source is unlocked then fetch
properties.why: bytes nobody pinned could be anything

properties.says: never when route is ungranted then run
properties.why: a model the owner never granted would read the owner's content

properties.says: never when route is ungranted then fetch
properties.why: bytes would be moved for a model the owner never granted

properties.says: never when runtime is not match then run
properties.why: unverified runtime bytes could compute anything

properties.says: never when weights is not match then run
properties.why: unverified weights would answer as if they were the locked model

properties.says: never when format is other then run
properties.why: a format without a locked runtime would run on unverified code

examples.request: locked onnx match match granted no
locked gguf match match granted no
locked onnx match match granted yes
unlocked onnx match match granted no
locked other match match granted no
locked onnx mismatch match granted no
locked onnx match mismatch granted no
locked onnx match match ungranted no
locked onnx missing match granted no
locked onnx match missing granted no
locked gguf missing missing granted no
locked onnx missing missing ungranted no
locked onnx mismatch missing ungranted no
unlocked gguf missing missing ungranted yes

meanings.run: run the model on locally held, verified bytes
meanings.fetch: fetch the missing locked bytes from this page, check them, and keep them in the browser
meanings.ask: ask the owner whether to route this model into the Prism
meanings.refuse: run and fetch nothing, and say why

otherwiseWhy: a pinned model with verified runtime and weights, granted by the owner, runs locally
